prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical 9:16 vintage high-society travel editorial of an adult woman seated on the polished mahogany deck of a classic wooden speedboat moving across a deep blue lake. She looks back over her shoulder with a relaxed smile, wearing tortoiseshell sunglasses, a loosely tied silk scarf, a classic black one-piece swimsuit, an open white linen overshirt, and a delicate gold watch. Include a straw hat on the deck, chrome fittings, white wake and water spray behind the boat, and softly blurred green mountains with lakeside villas in the distance. Use bright contrasty midday sun, crisp shadows, saturated blue water, warm wood, fine analog grain, a few water droplets on the lens, and a carefree nostalgic mood. No text, logo, watermark, or sexualized styling.
